description: This file contains the implementation of the IPTestAdministrator class, which manages shared memory, process synchronization, and inter-process communication for testing purposes. It includes methods for waiting on and signaling handshake values, handling process lifecycle, and cleaning up shared resources.

classes.name: IPTestAdministrator
classes.description: A class that manages inter-process communication and synchronization for testing, using shared memory, futexes, and process control.

methods.name: IPTestAdministrator
methods.description: Constructor that initializes shared memory, forks a child process, and executes parent and child callbacks.

methods.name: ~IPTestAdministrator
methods.description: Destructor that cleans up shared memory, terminates the child process if alive, and releases resources.

methods.name: Wait
methods.description: Waits for a specific handshake value to be set, with a timeout.

methods.name: Signal
methods.description: Signals waiting processes by updating the handshake value and waking waiters.
